statement:
I'll look up the Fitline payment first to verify the details before taking action.
**This payment should be refused: Tomas Vega cancelled his Fitline membership in writing on 3 July and received email confirmation of the cancellation, so the membership is no longer valid despite being marked as active in the system.**
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "active, renewing" status is wrong given the confirmed 3 July cancellation and says the payment "should be refused."
